baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated request for ajr and the exception of mawadda within al-qurba.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance cancels a work-for-wage claim and substitutes love maintained inside nearness. The focus inventory keeps both lived proximity and kin relation active, so the exception changes the medium of return from a payable object to a relationship.

activation_trace.role: The request branch supplies the solicitation that the explicit negation cancels.
The work-compensation branch supplies the rejected commercial measure of return.
The love branch supplies the positive relational medium placed after the exception.
The nearness branch makes proximity itself the sphere in which affection operates.
The kinship branch keeps concrete relations of descent available without exhausting the broader proximity image.

changed_reading.before: The speaker declines payment but asks for affection toward relatives.
changed_reading.after: The declaration converts recompense from a commodity into maintained relational nearness, with kinship and produced proximity remaining coexisting scopes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Whoever yaqtarif a hasana is increased, within it, in husn.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acquired good is not merely entered in an external ledger: it adheres to the doer, and the prepositional phrase places the increase inside that good. The movement from a discrete hasana to intensified husn makes one act a carrier whose quality expands.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition-that-clothes branch makes the gained act adhere to and characterize its doer.
The doing-good branch links the initial good unit and its expanded qualitative outcome.
The growth branch supplies the internal enlargement rather than a merely separate prize.

changed_reading.before: A good deed receives an additional reward.
changed_reading.after: A good act adheres to the agent and becomes an internally growing site in which a discrete good is intensified into fuller goodness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The increase in goodness closes with God as ghafur and shakur.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two closing qualities produce an asymmetry: damaging residue is covered and its bearer protected, while even a slight positive input is made visibly effective. Increase therefore belongs to a mercy-weighted evaluation rather than strict equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The protective covering of fault supplies attenuation on the negative side.
The small input whose effect becomes manifest supplies amplification on the positive side.
The growth branch turns that positive responsiveness into the stated operation of increase.

changed_reading.before: Forgiving and grateful are two reassuring divine attributes.
changed_reading.after: The close defines an asymmetric evaluation: failure is covered, while slight goodness is amplified until its effect appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated revelation frames the discourse as received knowledge, while the later restriction to conveyance denies the messenger custodial control. Because God is the subject of the good news and the messenger is commanded to say the no-wage clause, the disclaimer marks the message as an entrusted transmission rather than the speaker's monetizable property.

activation_trace.role: The spoken-command branch marks the human utterance as an explicitly commissioned saying.
The compensation branch identifies the ownership claim that is refused.
The divinely given report supplies the upstream source of the surah's speech.
The messenger-and-message branch defines the speaker as a sent carrier.
The guarding branch is explicitly negated as a form of coercive custody over the audience.
The delivery branch supplies the positively retained limit of the messenger's task.

structural_cues: The surah opens with revelation language and closes by returning to modes of divine communication.
In the focus, divine agency in giving good news is followed by the imperative to the messenger to speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelation, sending, denied guardianship, and restricted delivery; I infer that the no-fee statement follows this role architecture; a live alternative is that it is only a personal ascetic disclaimer.

changed_reading.before: The messenger personally waives a fee for his preaching.
changed_reading.after: The messenger cannot price or possess an entrusted divine communication; his role is voiced delivery without custodial control, and the relational exception is not a sale price.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly stages a movement from religious fragmentation and rivalry in the space between people toward divine gathering. Within that field, mawadda in nearness reads as an anti-fragmentation practice that maintains a connection across the very interval where rivalry opened a gap.

activation_trace.role: The love branch supplies the adhesive social force.
The proximity branch supplies the relation that affection is to preserve or produce.
The scattering branch supplies the explicitly prohibited social-religious counterforce.
The connection-between-parties branch identifies the relational interval damaged by rivalry.
The gathering-of-the-scattered branch supplies the opposed movement toward restored togetherness.

structural_cues: The command not to divide in 42:13 is followed by division caused by rivalry between people in 42:14.
The speaker's declaration in 42:15 ends with God gathering between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattering, a damaged between-space, gathering, love, and nearness; I infer that affection functions against fragmentation; a live alternative is that the focus exception concerns only a bounded kinship duty.

changed_reading.before: Mawadda is an affection owed within a preexisting near relation.
changed_reading.after: Mawadda becomes a counter-movement to fragmentation: it maintains or rebuilds nearness across a rivalry-damaged relational space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah ends by naming a great surplus after locating believers in expansive garden spaces. Its demonstrative is then repeated at the focus opening. This resolves the focus's initially sealed 'that' backward: the good news is anchored first in the preceding bounty, and the focus then unfolds the noncommercial and amplifying economy of that bounty.

activation_trace.role: The joy-opening report branch supplies the announcement whose deictic content needs resolution.
The spacious-place branch supplies the expansive setting of the announced state.
The surplus branch supplies the immediately named content picked up by the repeated demonstrative.

structural_cues: 42:22 closes with a demonstrative naming the great surplus, and 42:23 opens with the same demonstrative construction.
The focus's relative clause presents the picked-up content as what God announces to believing doers of good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent repeated demonstratives, gardens, and surplus; I infer backward deictic pickup; a live alternative is that the focus demonstrative points more broadly to the whole promise or forward to its own clauses.

changed_reading.before: The opening demonstrative vaguely introduces the promise stated in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: The focus first picks up the preceding great bounty in the gardens, then explains its relational, noncommercial, and amplifying logic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier harvest sequence gives the focus's internal increase a material mechanism: an intended harvest begins with cultivation and is increased in its own field. The later reprise joins the same believers and good works to response and surplus, so a hasana behaves like seed whose return grows within it and exceeds equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The acquired-and-worn branch makes the good an invested possession that remains with the doer.
The good-doing branch supplies both the planted unit and its qualitative yield.
The slight provision with a manifest effect supplies the disproportionate responsiveness of the yield.
The sowing-and-cultivation branch supplies the material analogy for an act that produces a later harvest.
The repeated growth branch directly parallels increase occurring within the intended harvest.
The answering branch makes increase a responsive relation rather than an automatic exchange rate.
The second repeated growth branch confirms the focus operation on the same believing doers of good.
The surplus branch names the excess beyond proportional return.

structural_cues: 42:20 and 42:23 share the sequence 'We increase for him in', first with harvest and then with the acquired good.
42:26 repeats believers, good works, increase, and surplus immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, two exact increase patterns, response, and surplus; I infer a seed-to-yield mechanism for hasana; a live alternative is that the agricultural language offers only rhetorical parallelism.

changed_reading.before: God adds a reward to a completed good deed.
changed_reading.after: The deed is cultivated like seed: response acts within it, turning its own quality into a surplus yield rather than paying a fixed external amount.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes sheer expansion from beneficial increase: unrestricted provision can produce transgression, so provision is apportioned by discerning measure. The focus's increase 'in it, in goodness' is therefore qualitative and pedagogical, not a promise of indiscriminate material enlargement.

activation_trace.role: The increase branch supplies the operation whose kind is constrained by the context.
The good-versus-ugly branch identifies improvement in quality as the stated direction of increase.
The expansion-and-abundance branch supplies the material kind of increase that can be granted or withheld.
The constriction-to-a-limited-measure branch supplies the counteroperation to expansion.
The fine and hidden precision branch makes provision a subtle calibration rather than raw quantity.
The abundance branch supplies the hypothetical excess explicitly linked to transgression.
The apportioned-gift branch identifies what is being regulated for the servants.
The discerning-measure branch supplies purposeful calibration after the warning about excess.

structural_cues: The focus specifies increase within the good and toward goodness, rather than naming material provision.
42:27 gives an explicit causal reason why unbounded expansion would not be beneficent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expansion, constriction, subtle precision, apportioned provision, and the transgression counterfactual; I infer that focus increase is calibrated formation; a live alternative is that spiritual and material increases remain independent topics.

changed_reading.before: Increase is an unrestricted enlargement of the reward for good.
changed_reading.after: Increase is measured care that deepens the goodness of the act and agent; more quantity can be withheld when it would deform them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence makes the focus's asymmetry explicit and social. Harm returns through what hands acquire, yet much is erased; believers deliberate and spend; equivalent redress is permitted, but pardon plus repair transfers the wage claim to God. The messenger takes no wage from people, while God underwrites relational repair and asks the community to reproduce forgiving restraint.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition that clothes its doer anchors the focus side of moral consequence.
The protective covering of fault anchors the focus's negative-side attenuation.
The visible effect of a slight input anchors the focus's positive-side amplification.
The acquired gain branch supplies the hand-made causal return of harmful action.
The relinquishing-punishment branch interrupts that causal return for much of what was acquired.
The extraction of judgment through mutual review turns relational care into shared deliberation.
The outgoing expenditure branch turns relational care into material circulation.
The relinquishing-punishment branch supplies a chosen departure from exact retaliation.
The reconciliation branch makes pardon constructive repair rather than passive surrender.
The compensation branch relocates payment for repair from the human audience to God.
The heart-abiding love branch, negated for wrongdoers, sets a justice boundary on relational affection.
The human act of protective forgiveness mirrors the focus's divine closing quality.

structural_cues: 42:30 pairs acquired harm with pardoning much, while the focus pairs acquired good with increase.
42:39-43 moves from justified defense through equivalence to pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness.
The no-wage statement in the focus is answered by 42:40 placing the repairer's wage upon God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired consequence, extensive pardon, consultation, spending, bounded redress, repair, transferred wage, and human forgiveness; I infer a community enactment of the focus's divine asymmetry; a live alternative is that these are adjacent ethical rulings without a shared economy.

changed_reading.before: God privately forgives faults and rewards good deeds, while mawadda is mainly an inward feeling.
changed_reading.after: The mercy-weighted evaluation becomes a social practice: deliberate together, circulate provision, restrain retaliation, repair relations, and leave the resulting wage claim with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later family language places kin relations between possible loss and unearned divine giving. This activates the kinship branch of al-qurba but removes entitlement: affection is care within a contingent gift, not a payment that purchases privilege or guarantees that a family remains gathered.

activation_trace.role: The love branch supplies the demanded quality of the near relation.
The kinship branch supplies the concrete family scope activated by the later sequence.
The rejected compensation branch prevents kin affection from functioning as a purchase.
The belonging-and-near-group branch supplies a family relation that can nevertheless be lost.
The gift-without-return branch frames children and their resulting relations as unpriced bestowal.
The pairing branch supplies the contingent formation of family configurations.

structural_cues: 42:45 describes loss of self and family rather than automatic salvation through belonging.
42:49-50 varies gifted children, pairing, and childlessness under divine giving and measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kin belonging, possible family loss, gift without return, and varied pairing; I infer that kinship is a non-entitling arena of mawadda; a live alternative is that al-qurba refers primarily to proximity rather than family.

changed_reading.before: Affection toward kin is the one compensatory claim made on the audience.
changed_reading.after: Kinship is one contingent, divinely gifted arena in which noncommercial affection must be practiced; it neither buys the message nor guarantees salvific privilege.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus request root to a gentle or hidden drawing-out image. It remains anchored to word 12 and coheres with the no-wage and conveyance clauses, but downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance, not a morphological translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated asking in la asalukum.

activation_trace.role: The gentle hidden extraction branch recasts the negated request as refusal to draw value out of the audience.
The compensation branch identifies what would otherwise be extracted.
The love branch prevents the exception from becoming another covert commodity.
The delivery branch supports a non-extractive messenger role limited to getting the message across.

changed_reading.before: The speaker does not ask for payment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speaker also refuses subtle extraction from the audience; affection must remain genuinely relational rather than a concealed fee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's secondary mapping of the increase root to carrying provisions. It remains anchored to the focus increase and gains a visible path mechanism from the surah's close, but downstream prose should present it as a travel-provision resonance, not replace the ordinary sense of growth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise nazid lahu fiha husna.

activation_trace.role: The carried-provision branch lets increased goodness function as supply for an onward passage.
The enacted-good branch identifies what becomes portable provision.
The gentle direction-to-a-path branch supplies movement requiring guidance.
The straight-road branch supplies the route for which goodness can serve as provision.

changed_reading.before: God increases the amount or quality of a good deed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the increase also provisions the doer with goodness for the guided road on which the surah finally places the message.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material fracture-setting branch of ajr is surprising and should not displace its ordinary compensation sense. It remains anchored because the focus joins ajr to affection and nearness, while 42:40 directly joins pardon, repair, and ajr; downstream prose should mark the splint image as a material analogy for relational repair.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rejected ajr immediately followed by affection in nearness.

activation_trace.role: The setting of a fracture supplies a material image for recompense as repaired alignment.
The love branch supplies the binding force of the proposed relational repair.
The nearness branch supplies the restored alignment sought by the repair.
The relinquishing-punishment branch removes pressure that would keep the relational fracture open.
The reconciliation branch explicitly supplies repair between estranged parties.
The repeated fracture-setting branch links repaired relation to a wage borne by God.

changed_reading.before: The messenger refuses a wage and asks instead for affection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the only fitting 'ajr' is the splinting of broken nearness through affection, while God assumes the actual compensation for pardon and repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses domains from joyful report to skin surface and then to the later noun 'human', so it is deliberately surprising. It remains anchored in the focus good-news root and in 42:51's same-root human recipient plus concealed communication, but prose must qualify it as a branch-image convergence rather than lexical identity.

activation_trace.role: The appearing surface branch lets the announced future become perceptible at the recipient's exterior.
The joy-opening report branch supplies the affective event that changes that surface.
The visible-skinned human branch identifies the embodied recipient of mediated divine speech.
The hidden imparting of knowledge supplies what crosses into human reception without direct possession.
The screening barrier supplies the concealed boundary across which the communication is mediated.

changed_reading.before: God reports a joyful future to His servants.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, hidden divine communication crosses a barrier and makes its promised future appear on the human surface as present joy.

strongest_changes: The repeated demonstrative resolves the good news backward to the great surplus and garden-state of 42:22.
The harvest and repeated-increase sequence turns hasana into seed whose goodness grows internally and responsively.
Measured provision prevents increase from being reduced to unrestricted material quantity.
Acquired harm is often erased while acquired good is amplified, and that divine asymmetry becomes communal pardon and repair.
The revelation and conveyance frame makes the no-wage clause a statement about entrusted message custody, not only personal renunciation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied an unusually tight chain of repeated wording: great surplus to 'that which He announces', harvest-increase to good-increase to surplus-increase, no human wage to a repairer's wage upon God, and divine forgiveness to human forgiveness. Split mappings also exposed contained extraction, splint, provision, and surface-mediated readings that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The backward reach of the opening demonstrative may be exclusive to 42:22 or may gather a broader promise.
Al-qurba can privilege kinship, lived proximity, or both; the packet supports coexistence but not final disambiguation.
The grammatical force of the exception can still affect whether mawadda is heard as requested return, sole residual claim, or description of the noncommercial relation.
The split-root and material-branch outliers are traceable activations but should remain explicitly exploratory.
